posts.title: Conventional Commit rules everything around me
posts.description: There’s a community standard out there called Conventional Commit for structured git-commit messages. posts.title: Write mo'
posts.description: I decided not to do #NaNoWriMo this year. Part of that is because I’ve never done it. Never even attempted it. Don’t even want to. Writing a novel is a life goal of mine, but cramming it all into one month isn’t for me. November is impossibly busy.
